title.heading: Molo
title.line: Learn isiXhosa the way it sounds.
title.sub: Every word has a real voice. The clicks are lessons, not footnotes.

phone.heading: Six questions, no account.
phone.body: Language, daily goal, listening and speaking. The app fits the learner before anyone signs anything.

phone.heading: The path, honestly empty.
phone.body: Nothing reaches a learner until an isiXhosa editor has approved it. Today that is nothing, and the app says so.

phone.heading: An age gate, not a sentence.
phone.body: 13 and over, 18 in South Africa. Birth year and country are checked and discarded.

phone.heading: Molo Plus, through RevenueCat.
phone.body: Unlimited hearts, streak freeze, offline units. It pays the speakers who record every word.

web.text: hellomolo.com. English or Norwegian in; isiXhosa is the pivot.
The editor dashboard: what stands between a draft and a learner.
A word without a studio or licensed recording does not publish. Two tiers of real voices, never TTS.
Every row carries a status. Learner surfaces query published, and only published.
One word: a gloss per source language, the audio tiers, and what is still missing.
Send to review. The CLI cannot publish; only a person in this dashboard can.
xh-morph: noun-class agreement generated by rules, golden-tested against forms a fluent speaker signs off.
The lexicon goes back to the community as a CC BY-SA data package.
